assessment: The scoped ordered regrouping preserves occurrence order and Boolean meaning in the abstract model. The 16 registered amendment propositions include the stated 167-operand witnesses and project the existing public bounds and field-order obligation; they do not establish parser or Java refinement. The spec keeps the accepted BLOCK artifact and history immutable, validates SOURCE output against unchanged public bounds, and makes transient traversal explicitly bounded. The 512-node and depth-512 policy is a credible finite implementation target subject to actual stack and resource testing. The numeric witness uses two-node abstract leaves and is not a general weighted-subtree depth theorem. All 251 earlier claims and the frozen r5 requirements remain binding; PostgreSQL through SQLean Parser is unchanged and commercial status remains NO_GO.
